title: ReMoA: Recursive Modular Adaptation via Sparse Latent Refinement in Multimodal Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.25299v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion models have achieved success in high-fidelity data synthesis, yet their capacity for more complex, structured reasoning such as text following remains constrained. While advances in language models have leveraged strategies such as latent reasoning and recursion to enhance text understanding capabilities, extending these to multimodal text-to-image generation tasks is challenging due to the continuous and non-discrete nature of visual tokens. To tackle this problem, we draw inspiration from modular human cognition and propose a Recursive Modular Adaptation (ReMoA) framework integrated into joint attention layers of conventional diffusion models, iteratively refining visual tokens over multiple recursion steps while efficiently sharing parameters via sparse selection of neural modules. Comprehensive evaluations on both class-conditioned ImageNet generation and text-to-image generation using the GenEval and DPG benchmar

translated_title: ReMoA：多模态扩散模型中基于稀疏潜在精化的递归模块化适配
translated_abstract: 扩散模型在高保真数据合成方面已取得成功，但其在遵循文本等更复杂的结构化推理方面的能力仍然受限。尽管语言模型领域的进展利用了潜在推理和递归等策略来增强文本理解能力，但由于视觉token具有连续、非离散的特性，将这些策略扩展到多模态文本到图像生成任务中面临挑战。为解决这一问题，我们从人类模块化认知中汲取灵感，提出了递归模块化适配框架，该框架被集成到传统扩散模型的联合注意力层中，通过多次递归步骤迭代地精炼视觉token，同时借助神经模块的稀疏选择实现高效的参数共享。在类条件ImageNet生成任务以及使用GenEval和DPG基准的文本到图像生成任务上的全面评估……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出递归模块化适配框架ReMoA，通过在扩散模型联合注意力层中进行多步递归迭代精炼视觉token，并利用稀疏模块选择实现高效参数共享，从而提升多模态文本到图像生成中的结构化推理与文本遵循能力。
en_tdlr: ReMoA is a recursive modular adaptation framework that iteratively refines visual tokens over multiple recursion steps within the joint attention layers of diffusion models, using sparse selection of neural modules for efficient parameter sharing to enhance structured reasoning and text-following in multimodal text-to-image generation.
